Deployment Volume

By application date
Job Order Fill Rate
Open job orders today · at-risk = deadline within 14 days and under 50% filled
Medical Status
By application date
⏱ Time to Deploy
Days from application to deployment, for applicants whose deployment date falls in the selected range
🔻 Pipeline Funnel & Drop-off
From the server-side stage history: how far applicants who applied in this range got, how long today's pipeline has sat in each stage, and the last stage reached before a backout or rejection
💰 Profitability
Employer fees settled − commissions released (+ reversals) − expenses, in the range. All in USD at each record's own rate.
🧾 Commission Liability
Owed but not yet paid out (today, not range-limited)
📬 Employer Fees Receivable
Pending fees by age since they were raised (today, not range-limited)
🩺 Data Quality
Missing information that weakens the numbers above · click to review
📎 Document Completeness
Active applicants and their approved documents
